lens: time-constrained recruiter task completion, decision clarity, safe recovery, and inspectable outcomes

findings.observation: The Web flow completed from local sign-in through fact review, separate effect approval, and verified readback, but no uncoached first-use recording was captured.
findings.evidence: docs/evaluations/overnight/final/web-review-sequence.json records the real Chrome sequence; docs/evaluations/overnight/final/web-desktop-before-review.png and web-desktop-verified-light.png show its endpoints.
findings.user_impact: A recruiter can complete the work, but the evidence does not prove that a first-time operator will understand every transition without help.
findings.recommendation: Run one uncoached recruiter walkthrough and record where the operator hesitates or misstates the difference between confirmation, approval, and verification.
findings.verification: A first-time reviewer completes the same TS-CORE-01 path without prompting and correctly explains all three authority states.

findings.observation: The reviewed Web slice has a narrow screenshot, but the authenticated backend-owned sequence was not directly repeated at 390 px.
findings.evidence: docs/evaluations/overnight/final/web-review-sequence.json names the missing direct 390 px run; docs/evaluations/overnight/final/web-reviewed-slice-mobile-light.png is slice-only evidence.
findings.user_impact: The desktop path is proven, while a recruiter using a narrow browser may still encounter an unobserved layout or action-reachability issue.
findings.recommendation: Repeat the authenticated edit, confirm, approve, and readback sequence at 390 px in a controllable real browser.
findings.verification: The same backend version and verified outcome remain reachable at 390 px with no clipped evidence or hidden primary action.

strengths: The real Web flow makes the current evidence, four proposed facts, separate confirmation, one bounded action preview, and verified destination outcome visible in order.
Fact confirmation leaves the action unapproved, and approval still does not display success until destination readback matches.
The offline screen preserves the review state and the recovered screen returns to the same verified backend version.
The actual Codex host loads the installed Skill from the personal cache and returns the same proposal-only TS-CORE-01 semantic packet without repository plugin-source access or an external effect.
open_questions: Would a recruiter prefer the four same-source confirmations as one explicit batch decision after inspecting each fact?
